# @danitesler/ayywi

> The AI-first design system (say "AY-wee": AI + UI). One CSS class contract for HTML, Vue, Svelte, Angular, server templates, plus typed React components, a linter and an MCP server.

Dark-first, monochrome frame with colour coming from content. Tokens are CSS custom properties prefixed --ayy-, classes are prefixed ayy-. Works in any framework; React components and custom elements render the same markup. Themes, density, brands and RTL are attributes on any element.

## Start here

- [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt): the whole contract in one file — rules, patterns, tokens, every component's API (examples are in the per-component pages)
- [manifest/components.json](manifest/components.json): the same, as JSON
- [README.md](README.md): install and usage per framework
- [ai/AGENTS.snippet.md](ai/AGENTS.snippet.md): rules to paste into a consuming project's AGENTS.md (or run `npx @danitesler/ayywi init`)
- [ai/skills/ayywi/SKILL.md](ai/skills/ayywi/SKILL.md): how to build a page or an app with ayywi, step by step
- MCP server: `npx @danitesler/ayywi mcp` (tools: list_components, get_component, search, get_tokens, get_rules, create_brand, lint)

## Patterns

Screens every app builds the same way, from several components:

- [Settings](llms/pattern-settings.md): Settings open in a large dialog over the app, the way they do in Notion and Claude. The sidebar lists the sections, the main area shows the one you picked, and on phones it goes full screen. Don't use a small or side dialog, or tabs inside a page.
- [Data explorer](llms/pattern-data-explorer.md): A searchable, filterable, sortable view of records or media, with multi-select and bulk actions. It's built from a page header, a filter bar, a table or card grid with quick actions, and a floating action bar that appears while items are selected. It also covers the loading, empty and error states.
- [Marketing page](llms/pattern-marketing-page.md): A public website or landing page: a sticky header, a hero, feature and pricing sections, an FAQ and a footer. Sections are divided by soft separators, and the header folds into a menu on phones.

## Components

Each links to its own page (classes, React props, accessibility, do and don't, copy-ready HTML and React); llms-full.txt has the same sections without the examples.

### Actions

- [Button](llms/button.md): The control for starting an action, like saving, submitting or opening something. It comes in a few weights, from a strong primary button to quieter ones for secondary actions.
- [Hover actions](llms/hover-actions.md): Small buttons that appear over a picture, a video or a card when someone points at it, for quick actions like copy, annotate or pin. They stay out of the way until needed, and a tooltip names each one.
- [Toolbar](llms/toolbar.md): A row or column of tools for one surface, like an editor, a canvas or a text selection. It's a single tab stop with arrow keys between the tools, and can be fixed, floating or vertical.
- [Action bar](llms/action-bar.md): A bar that appears at the bottom of the screen once someone selects rows or cards in a table, grid or list. It shows how many are selected and offers actions that apply to all of them, such as archive or delete. It goes away when the selection is cleared.
- [Dropdown menu](llms/menu.md): A list of actions that opens from a button. It supports submenus and works fully from the keyboard.
- [Command palette](llms/command.md): A search box above a list of actions and places, so people can find and run things from the keyboard. It can sit inline on a page or in a popover, or open as a dialog from a shortcut.
- [Floating action button](llms/fab.md): A round floating button for the main action of a phone screen, like composing or adding something. It stays in the corner over the content and can show a label when extended.

### Navigation

- [Navbar](llms/navbar.md): The header at the top of a website, with the brand on one side and links and actions on the other. It stays in view as the page scrolls, and on phones the links fold into a menu.
- [App shell](llms/app-shell.md): The frame around a web app: a sidebar for navigation next to a main area where the content lives. On phones the sidebar turns into a bottom tab bar or a drawer. The same frame also holds settings screens.
- [Bottom nav](llms/bottom-nav.md): The tab bar of a phone app. It keeps the main destinations at the bottom of the screen where a thumb can reach them, each with an icon and a short label. Inside an App shell it replaces the sidebar on phones.
- [Top bar](llms/top-bar.md): The header of a phone screen, with a back button, the screen title and a few actions. It stays at the top, and can hold a search bar or a segmented control beneath it.
- [Footer](llms/footer.md): The bottom of a website page: the brand with a short line about the product, groups of links, and copyright and legal links.
- [Breadcrumb](llms/breadcrumb.md): A trail of links that shows where the current page sits in the site, from the top level down. It lets people jump back to any page above it.
- [Pagination](llms/pagination.md): Controls for moving between the pages of a long table or list: previous, next and page numbers. On phones it shrinks to the essentials.
- [Steps](llms/steps.md): A progress indicator for a short flow like sign-up or checkout. It shows which step you're on, which are done and which are still to come.
- [Table of contents](llms/toc.md): A table of contents for long pages. It lists links to the sections beside the content and highlights the one being read.
- [Tree](llms/tree.md): A hierarchical list of folders, files or records: groups that open and close with a chevron, one selected row and arrow-key navigation. Use it to browse a folder or file structure, or as a picker inside a card.

### Forms

- [Field](llms/field.md): A wrapper that ties a label, an input and its hint or error message together with consistent spacing. Use it around any form control.
- [Input](llms/input.md): A single-line text field for names, emails, passwords, search and other short text. It can hold icons, addons and buttons inside the field.
- [PIN input](llms/pin-input.md): One box per character for verification codes, two-factor authentication tokens and passcodes. Typing advances to the next box, Backspace steps back, and pasting or SMS autofill fills the whole code at once.
- [Search bar](llms/search-bar.md): A rounded search field with a magnifier and a clear button, often used at the top of a phone list. It's a real search form, so phones show a search key on the keyboard.
- [Filter bar](llms/filter-bar.md): A bar that brings together everything needed to filter a list, table or feed: quick filter tabs, filter menus, search, and the filters currently applied with a way to clear them all.
- [Sorting](llms/sorting.md): A dropdown for choosing how a list, table or feed is ordered. It matches the filter bar and sits next to it.
- [Textarea](llms/textarea.md): A multi-line text field for longer text like comments and descriptions. It can grow as you type.
- [Mentions](llms/mentions.md): A multi-line text field that opens a floating suggestions list right at the caret when someone types @ or #, for tagging teammates, channels or issues inside comments and notes.
- [Block editor](llms/block-editor.md): A Notion-style document editor made of blocks: text, three headings, bulleted, numbered and to-do lists, toggles that hide the blocks nested under them, tables of plain-text cells (row and column grips that open a scoped menu, drag to reorder, a selection you can clear, move, copy or delete from the keyboard, sorting, resizable and aligned columns, header row and column), quotes, callouts, code, dividers, images, embeds and files. Enter starts a new block and Backspace joins it to the one above, the arrows move between blocks as if they were one text, Markdown shortcuts and / turn a line into another block, a quiet bar formats a selection, @ inserts mention chips, and the handle in the gutter drags blocks (one or a selection of them) to a new place.
- [Inline edit](llms/inline-edit.md): A value that becomes an input where it sits: a page or card title, a project name, a version, a due date. Click it or press Enter to edit, Enter saves, Esc cancels, blur saves, and a multiline field grows as you type and saves on Mod+Enter.
- [Select](llms/select.md): A dropdown for choosing one option from a list. It's the native select with a nicer list on desktop, and the system picker on touch devices.
- [Combobox](llms/combobox.md): A text field that filters a list as you type, for picking one option from a long set like a city, a customer or a time zone. The options open under the field and follow the standard accessible pattern.
- [Tag input](llms/tag-input.md): A field that turns what you type into removable chips, for tags, labels or email recipients. It can also suggest options as you type.
- [Record picker](llms/record-picker.md): A tag field whose chips are records picked from a list: one person to assign, many labels to apply. Type to filter, Enter picks the active record, Backspace in the empty field removes the last, and a create row turns new text into a record.
- [Transfer list](llms/transfer-list.md): A dual-list shuttle for moving items between an available column and a selected column, such as role permissions, export columns or team members. Each column supports live filtering, select-all and keyboard navigation.
- [Date & time picker](llms/date-time-picker.md): Pickers for a date, a date range, a time, or a date with a time. They work inline or in a popover, and can be used fully from the keyboard.
- [Color picker](llms/color-picker.md): A panel for choosing any colour. It combines an area for shade and brightness, sliders for hue and transparency, a hex field and a row of preset colours.
- [Icon picker](llms/icon-picker.md): A searchable grid of icons and emoji with a remove button, for marking a column, project, page or label with a symbol. It sits in a Popover or as the submenu panel of a Menu.
- [Checkbox](llms/checkbox.md): A box for turning an option on or off, or for picking several items from a list. It's the native checkbox with a clearer look, and it can show a mixed state when only some of a group is selected.
- [Radio](llms/radio.md): A set of options where exactly one can be chosen. It's built on native radio buttons, grouped under a legend.
- [Segmented control](llms/segmented-control.md): A short row of options where one is always selected, for switching a view, a range or a setting that changes what you see. It looks like tabs but works like radio buttons.
- [Chip](llms/chip.md): A compact pill for filters and choices. Chips can be switched on and off, work as single or multiple choice, or be removable when they stand for filters that are applied.
- [Color swatch](llms/swatch.md): Round colour options for picking one colour, as for a tag, a list or a drawing tool. It can include a "no colour" option and an "any colour" option that opens the colour picker.
- [Choice card](llms/choice-card.md): A large option for picking one or more things that need more explanation than a radio label, like plans, delivery methods or add-ons. The whole card is clickable and works as a normal radio or checkbox.
- [Slider](llms/slider.md): A control for choosing a value, or a range between two values, by dragging a handle along a track. It's a native range input, so the keyboard, forms and screen readers work as usual.
- [Number field](llms/number-field.md): A number input with minus and plus buttons, for small quantities like seats, guests or items. Typing and arrow keys work as in any number field.
- [Rating](llms/rating.md): Stars for picking a score in a review or feedback form, or displaying an existing average score with whole or half stars. Interactive ratings use native radio buttons, so arrow keys and forms work out of the box.
- [File upload](llms/dropzone.md): An area for dropping files or clicking to choose them. It's a real file input underneath, so it works without extra code, and it pairs with a list to show what was picked.
- [Switch](llms/switch.md): An on/off control for a setting that takes effect right away. It's a native checkbox with a switch look and the right accessible role.
- [Shortcut](llms/shortcut.md): Keyboard shortcuts written once and shown correctly for each device. It also includes a recorder that lets people set their own shortcut, and a list for help screens.
- [Settings](llms/settings.md): A layout for preferences as rows, with a label and a short hint on one side and the control on the other, grouped under headings. A row can also link to a sub-page or run an action like signing out.

### Layout

- [Page header](llms/page-header.md): The top of a screen in an app: the page title, a line of description and the page's main actions, with an optional breadcrumb above. On phones the actions move below the title.
- [Showcase](llms/showcase.md): A container for previewing a design at different screen sizes. It has a toolbar for switching devices and can show the code behind the preview.
- [Card](llms/card.md): A surface that groups related content so it reads as one unit, like a project, a summary or a block of settings. It can react to hover when it's clickable, and it has a media version for captures, recordings and pictures.
- [Tabs](llms/tabs.md): Tabs for switching between panels of related content on the same page. They can be used fully from the keyboard.
- [Accordion](llms/accordion.md): A stack of sections that expand and collapse, for FAQs and for settings with a lot of detail. Only the heading shows until someone opens a section, and opening one can close the others.
- [Carousel](llms/carousel.md): A row of slides that scrolls sideways, with buttons to move to the next or previous one. It suits galleries, testimonials and featured items. It uses native scrolling, so swiping and the keyboard work without extra code.
- [Separator](llms/separator.md): A thin line that divides blocks of content, between sections of a page or between items in a row.
- [Drag and drop](llms/drag-drop.md): Standard drag and drop for reordering items and moving them between areas: a floating preview follows the pointer, drop targets show hover states (ready, over, reject), and a primary line indicates the exact drop position. Fully accessible with arrow keys.

### Overlays

- [Dialog](llms/dialog.md): A window that opens over the page and asks for attention, for confirmations, forms and short tasks. It can be centred, slide in from the side as a drawer, or rise from the bottom on phones. It's built on the native dialog element, so focus and Esc work properly.
- [Popover](llms/popover.md): A small floating panel attached to a button, for extra content or controls that don't need a full dialog. It closes when you click outside or press Esc.
- [Tooltip](llms/tooltip.md): A short hint that appears when someone hovers or focuses an element, for naming icon buttons or giving a little extra detail. It stays inside the screen and never gets clipped.

### Feedback

- [Alert](llms/alert.md): A message placed in the flow of a page to tell someone something they should notice, like a warning, an error or a confirmation. It can carry a title, a short explanation and actions.
- [Toast](llms/toast.md): A short message that appears briefly to confirm something happened. It shows above everything else on the page, including dialogs, and can carry images or previews as well as text.
- [Progress](llms/progress.md): A bar that shows how far along something is, or that work is happening when the end isn't known.
- [Progress ring](llms/progress-ring.md): Progress shown as a ring that fills up, for goals, timers and uploads in small spaces. It can show a known amount or an unknown one, with a value or an icon in the middle.
- [Spinner](llms/spinner.md): A small loading indicator for short waits, like inside a button or beside some text. For loading a larger area, use a skeleton instead.
- [Skeleton](llms/skeleton.md): A placeholder shaped like the content that's loading, so the page doesn't jump when the real content arrives.
- [Empty state](llms/empty-state.md): What a list, table or page shows when it has nothing to display yet, or nothing matches a search. It explains why it's empty and offers the action that fills it.

### Data display

- [Badge](llms/badge.md): A small label that marks the status, category or count of something, like "New" or "Paid". It can include a status dot for things that are live.
- [Status dot](llms/status-dot.md): A small coloured dot that shows the state of something, like someone being online, a live stream or a server's health.
- [Keyboard hint](llms/kbd.md): A small keycap for showing a keyboard key or shortcut in help text, menus and tooltips. Shortcuts adapt to the platform, so Mac users see their own symbols.
- [Text highlight](llms/text-highlight.md): A way to mark text inside a sentence, for search matches or phrases that need attention. It's subtle by default, with colour variants for warnings, errors, successes and info.
- [Avatar](llms/avatar.md): A small picture that stands for a person or a workspace. When there's no image, or it fails to load, it shows initials instead.
- [Icon](llms/icon.md): A single icon from the Hugeicons library that ayywi uses. It follows the colour and size of the text around it.
- [Icon tile](llms/icon-tile.md): A rounded app-icon tile that gives a product, plugin or service a recognisable mark, with the glyph tinted in its accent colour.
- [Stat](llms/stat.md): A big number with a short label, for headline figures like downloads, views or revenue.
- [List](llms/list.md): Rows of people, records or settings, each with an image or icon, a title, a description and something at the end like a value or a control. A row can be a link.
- [Property list](llms/property-list.md): A record's attributes as a definition list: a muted term (an icon and a label) and its value, side by side, wrapping under each other when the value doesn't fit.
- [Swipe actions](llms/swipe.md): A list row that slides sideways to reveal actions, the way phone mail and task apps do. It works with touch, mouse and keyboard, and follows the reading direction.
- [Timeline](llms/timeline.md): A list of events in time order, like a history, a changelog or a project's milestones, joined by a vertical line with status markers and timestamps.
- [Frame](llms/frame.md): A browser window drawn around a screenshot, a video or a demo, for showing a product in context on marketing pages and in docs.
- [Chat](llms/chat.md): The layout of a conversation, with other people's messages on one side and the reader's own on the other. It includes a typing indicator and quick-reply buttons, for assistants and support chats.
- [Code block](llms/code-block.md): A container for showing code, with a header, a file name, a copy button and optional line numbers. It styles syntax highlighting without tying you to a particular highlighter.
- [Table](llms/table.md): Data table with quiet hairlines, muted sentence-case headers and hover rows, styled on plain table elements under .ayy-table. Optional frame with toolbar and pager; densities, column lines, sticky header, pinned and resizable columns; sortable, selectable (including drag-to-select across rows), expandable, grouped, linked and disabled rows; column menus with icons, insertion and wrapping; inline editable, empty, truncated and media cells; row actions. Cell content stays inside its column and ends in … unless the column wraps.
- [Grid](llms/grid.md): A grid of cards that can be selected, for media, projects, posts and records. It combines card selection, quick actions on each item and a select-all control, and works with the Action bar.
- [Chart](llms/chart.md): Charts for reading data at a glance: bars, lines, areas, pies and donuts, scatters, gauges and more. They're drawn with plain markup and CSS instead of a charting library, and each comes with a data table for screen readers. Colours, hover details and a switchable legend are built in.
